hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *src/use_cases/*.py) bad=$(grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(from|import)[[:space:]]+(fastapi|sqlalchemy|qdrant_client|minio|langchain|llama_index|cv2|insightface)([[:space:]\.]|$)' "$f" || true); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "Clean Architecture violation in $f — use_cases must not import infra:" >&2; echo "$bad" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
